import os
import hou import fxhoudinimcp_server.startup as mcp
if mcp.is_running(): lines = [ f"Status: RUNNING on port {mcp.get_port()}", f"Bind address: {os.environ.get('FXHOUDINIMCP_BIND', '127.0.0.1')}", ] elif mcp.is_starting(): # Auto-start confirms readiness on a worker thread, so there is a window # where the server is neither stopped nor confirmed running. lines = [ f"Status: STARTING on port {mcp.get_port()}", "Auto-start is still confirming the server answers.", ] else: lines = [ "Status: STOPPED", f"Configured port: {mcp.get_port()}", "", "Use MCP > Start Server, or set FXHOUDINIMCP_AUTOSTART=1", ]
lines.append(f"Houdini pid: {os.getpid()}") hou.ui.displayMessage("\n".join(lines), title="FXHoudini-MCP Status")
